chapters.label: Vienna, 2008
chapters.text: Vienna, 2008, the Euro final. Spain, in red, play Germany, in white. Xavi looks up and rolls a perfect pass through. Fernando Torres races past Lahm, chips the keeper... goal!

chapters.label: Always looking
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Xavi is always looking for space. One touch, then a pass weighted just right, behind the defence.

chapters.label: Champions
chapters.text: Torres gets there first and lifts it over Jens Lehmann. Spain are champions of Europe!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball moving with short, simple passes. Get it, give it, and look for space to control the game.
